title: Unreadable findings are a named error, never a pass
goal: {{castBrand}} needs {{castApp}} to fail safely, while it is {{castTask}}, if the inspector sends back something the gateway cannot read.
obstacle: An answer that cannot be read could be mistaken for no findings, which would turn a broken inspector into an open door.
control: The gateway returns the named error inspector_malformed_findings and does not call the model. Neither fail open nor advisory authority turns it into a pass.
